page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the instance delivers modest performance. In stress-ng and Geekbench tests, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively, reflecting the older architecture of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. However, the instance shows average performance in large-block uncached memory read and write operations, reaching 40.42 GB/sec and 35.62 GB/sec. Passmark CPU scores and extended instruction tests also rank in the middle 50%. For specialized tasks, LLM inference with a small 135M model achieves average speeds of 464.08 tokens/sec for prompt processing, though performance drops significantly to the bottom 10% when running larger 7B models.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is its reliance on legacy CPU hardware, which limits its execution speed for compute-intensive tasks like cryptography, database operations, and compression. Because it lacks local storage, all storage operations must rely on network-attached volumes. Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and small-scale application hosting that require predictable CPU allocation but do not demand high-performance computing.
